clusters.label: Wild beasts and the hunt
clusters.description: Wolves, boars, lions and huntsmen: the untamed world beyond the settlement and those who hunt in it.

clusters.label: Lights of the sky
clusters.description: Sun, moon and stars against the dark: the heavens as light, order and time.

clusters.label: Trees and the forest
clusters.description: Firs, pines and branches: the tree as a living being, a sacred tree and the forest around it.

clusters.label: Waters and crossings
clusters.description: Seas, rivers, ships and fish: water as the world's edge, its source and the way across it.

clusters.label: Death and kinship
clusters.description: Passages where death meets mother, father and lineage: mortality told through family and descent.
